build_crosstest_binary: build a cross-test binary comparing Subzero and llc translation for a target architecture
test_subzero_translation: test Subzero translation against llc by compiling C/C++ test files with --test and --driver arguments
run_cross_test_x8632: run a cross-test on x8632 target with --target x8632 --test testfile.c --driver driver.c --prefix sz --output executable
run_cross_test_arm32: run a cross-test on arm32 target with --target arm32 --mattr neon --test testfile.c --driver driver.c
build_nonsfi_cross_test: build a non-SFI cross-test binary with --nonsfi 1 --target x8664 --test testfile.c --driver driver.c
